defaultGearVaultTabIndex.label: Default Gear Vault Stash Tab Index
defaultGearVaultTabIndex.description: Zero-based personal stash tab index receiving Ctrl+Click routed gear matching the configured Gear Vault class filter.

defaultGearClassFilter.label: Default Gear Vault Class Filter
defaultGearClassFilter.description: Default equipment class routed to the Gear Vault tab (Helmets, Body Armours, Gloves, Boots, Belts, Rings, Amulets, or Weapons).

enableStockAffinityMapping.label: Enable Stock Affinity Bit Mapping
enableStockAffinityMapping.description: When true, maps matching Gear Vault items to the configured stock StashTabAffinityId bit (0..21) via RegisterStockAffinityRule.

stockAffinityBitId.label: Stock Affinity Bit Id
stockAffinityBitId.description: Stock StashTabAffinityId bit index (0..21) assigned when stock affinity mapping is enabled.

showAltTooltipAffixTags.label: Show Alt-Held Tooltip Affix Tags
showAltTooltipAffixTags.description: Injects [Affix Tags: ...] and tier summary sections into stock item tooltips when holding Alt.

maxVaultEntriesPerSync.label: Max Gear Vault Entries Per Sync
maxVaultEntriesPerSync.description: Upper limit on vault items returned per Gear Vault state synchronization message.
